BUILDPLAN: M-03 — Wave 0 (§3) · also delivers Tier B rank 3 (US-73)

Scope (verbatim): Magic links (256-bit random, hash stored, single-use, 15-min TTL), session cookie middleware, bearer-token middleware, scope resolution from `memberships`, **one-click organizer/speaker demo login — `POST /api/v1/auth/demo` 403s and sets no cookie unless the target event's `demo_mode = 1`** (SPEC §4.1, guardrail G6/A-5), on-screen magic link in demo mode, **auth mail (`magic_link_login`, `draft_resume`, `task_link`) enqueues an `outbox` row and never calls Resend directly — the queue consumer is the only sender (G3/A-3)**, `POST /admin/reset-demo` + product button + `npm run reset:demo` (idempotent, safe mid-judging, never partially-reset — **US-73 ranks in Tier B but is built here**, because the demo logins need it from the first deploy). **The route enqueues the reseed to a Queue and returns a job id the button polls**, and the reseed writes with `suppress_mirror` so it does not re-queue the entire Airtable base, enqueuing **one** reconcile job at the end (§3.9/§4.1).

File surface: `src/routes/auth.routes.ts`, `src/lib/auth/*`, `src/routes/admin-ops.routes.ts`

ACs: AC-1, AC-2, AC-107, AC-214, **AC-230**
Hours: 4
Workflow: inline-full
Shared files: none — module-local (§7 keyword-safe naming: no `utils.ts`, no bare `index.ts`, no `helpers.ts`). The `reset:demo` script name is registered by M-06, not here.
Deps: M-02
Audits that key off this ticket: A-5 (cookie scope + session issuance), A-11 (reset drill)
Plan: filled in by delegator's plan phase

# Model switch: Kimi → Claude (operator decision, 2026-08-10)

This ticket's delegator was running on **Kimi** (Kimi Code / Moonshot, 15x coding
plan). Atin's call on 2026-08-10: the output is not meeting the bar, and the
remaining tickets move to **Claude**. Recording the exact state at handover so a
fresh delegator can decide what to keep rather than guess.

## State at handover

Branch `mrq-3-auth`, worktree `../Marquee-worktrees/mrq-3-auth`.
**Nothing is committed** — `master..HEAD` is empty. All of the below is untracked
working-tree state, so it survives on disk but has no PR, no review, and no history.

| File | Lines |
|---|---|
| `src/routes/auth.routes.ts` | 197 |
| `src/lib/reset-demo/demo-fixture.ts` | 102 |
| `src/lib/auth/magic-links.ts` | 90 |
| `src/lib/auth/auth-middleware.ts` | 86 |
| `src/lib/auth/scope-resolution.ts` | 86 |
| `src/lib/reset-demo/reseed-demo.ts` | 84 |
| `src/routes/admin-ops.routes.ts` | 79 |
| `src/lib/auth/auth-sessions.ts` | 66 |
| `src/lib/auth/auth-mail.ts` | 57 |
| `src/lib/reset-demo/reset-jobs.ts` | 44 |
| `src/lib/reset-demo/reset-consumer.ts` | 39 |
| `src/lib/auth/random-token.ts` | 33 |

**963 lines, zero test files.** The contract requires every test name to carry its
`AC-nnn ·` prefix and `trace:ac` blocks merge on uncovered `auto` ACs, so this
cannot merge as-is regardless of code quality. Budget the tests as part of the
remaining work, not as a follow-up.

## Verify these against the contract before keeping the code

Two adversarial findings land squarely inside this ticket's scope, and the code was
written before both were folded in. Check them explicitly:

- **B-2** — `POST /api/v1/auth/demo` must return **403 unless the target event's
  `demo_mode = 1`**, with no session cookie set. Without the gate every self-hosted
  instance ships a one-click owner login, and `check:readme` proves a stranger can
  stand one up. Assertion belongs under AC-2; audit A-5 owns the surface.
- **B-8** — auth mail has no direct-send path. `magic_link_login`, `draft_resume`
  and `task_link` are outbox trigger keys; the auth route **enqueues**, it never
  calls Resend. A-3 asserts that no module imports the Resend client except the
  queue consumer, and `src/lib/auth/auth-mail.ts` is exactly where that boundary
  gets violated by accident. Also confirm `outbox.send_policy` is respected.
- **F-13 ruling** — reset stays **manual**. No unattended cron. If
  `src/lib/reset-demo/reset-jobs.ts` schedules anything recurring, that contradicts
  the operator ruling of 2026-08-09.
- **F-12** — `reset:demo` must short-circuit the Airtable change feed
  (`last_write_source='marquee'` + `suppress_mirror`, one reconcile job at the end)
  and enqueue the reseed rather than doing it in one Worker invocation.

## Contract changes to pick up before continuing

The worktree is on a pre-`1507bff` commit. Rebase on `master` first — the adversarial
pass closed out on 2026-08-10 and touched the harness contract:

- **`check:api` no longer asserts CLI-registry parity on every PR.** That half skips
  with a printed notice until `cli/` exists (MRQ-36 / M-38, Tier B rank 19). The
  served-JSON and rendered-docs half runs from the first PR. Before this fix, every
  PR opened against `check:api` failed on a registry no ticket has built yet.
- `SPEC.md` §4.2 names `/i/:uid.ics`, `/agenda.json` and the public SSR pages as a
  deliberate allowlist against the "`/api/v1` prefix throughout" rule.
- `EVALUATION.md` §1.2 adds the e2e split-do-not-delete rule; §5 records the
  desktop-only admin SPA as a non-goal.
- `SPEC.md` §3.9 gives the Airtable row counts a refresh owner (the daily keepalive)
  and renders them "as of `last_sync_at`".

Full disposition of the adversarial pass — 8/8 BLOCKING, 22/22 FIX, 8/8 NOTE — is in
`sequence/research/contract-adversarial.md`.

data.body: Rebased twice onto forgejo/master (MRQ-8/API-core, then MRQ-14/uploads — both merged mid-implementation). Resolved src/index.ts conflicts as a union both times; second rebase hit the identical *.routes.ts manifest-glob collision MRQ-14 already resolved the same way (routes/uploads.direct.ts, mounted ahead of the generated API router) — unioned both mounts. PR body updated to name the AC-214 test (tests/integration/auth-tokens.test.ts: 'CONTRACT · reviewer scope does not cross events') per the Orchestrator's ruling, and to recommend folding MRQ-3's route-manifest deviation into MRQ-59 alongside MRQ-14's. pr-gate re-run clean after each rebase (final: 70/70 tests, trace:ac 0 uncovered/0 errors). HEAD now 620a4a0, PR #8 reports mergeable=true.

Merged as PR #8 (squash a8792123). GUARDRAILS HAND-REVIEWED: AC-2 asserts 403 with no set-cookie when demo_mode=0, 200 with session cookie when demo_mode=1, speaker role 403s. AC-214 enforced at three layers including a schema CHECK rejecting org-wide reviewer memberships — stronger than the contract required. pr-gate green after both rebases (70/70). Cuts named in PR body: product Reset-demo button (route + CLI ship), manual wrangler-dev pass (substituted with real-D1 integration tests). Route-manifest deviation folded into MRQ-59; CredentialResolver adapter raised as MRQ-60.
